entry.title: Market brief — Wednesday 18 Nov 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on Wednesday 18 November 2026 the Nifty 50 closed at 25,227.95 (-159.45, -0.63%) and the Sensex at 82,031.81 (-500.38, -0.61%), giving back part of Tuesday's nine-month high, with the rupee 7 paise stronger at 93.44 per dollar (Reuters put the previous close at 93.47). IBJA's 12:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at Rs 1,31,505 per 10 g (-2,913) and 999 silver at Rs 1,64,506 per kg (-4,444). The next session is Thursday 19 November 2026.
